lines: Parsons is more than a brewery — it’s an experience. A must-visit every time!

Parsons Brewing Company is always our first stop when we arrive in Prince Edward County, and for good reason — it’s everything you want in a PEC experience. The setting is charming, welcoming, and quintessentially County, with rustic buildings, wide-open space, and thoughtful touches throughout.

claims.quote: portions slightly small for the price

lines: Parsons Brewing Company offers a lovely atmosphere for friends to enjoy craft beer and delicious food. Reviewers praise the outstanding beer selection, with highlights like the Crushable Pilsner and flavorful dishes such as the pork belly and smash burger. The service is excellent despite busy night
